result.summary: Deletes the deprecated `removeprunedfunds` RPC and removes all wallet internal transaction deletion code. Also stops pruning watchonly transactions from migrated wallets during legacy wallet migration, since unowned transactions do not affect balance calculations.
result.problem: Maintaining wallet transaction deletion functionality adds code complexity and surface area for an operation considered harmful or unnecessary. The `removeprunedfunds` RPC was previously deprecated in v32, and retaining watchonly transactions after wallet migration is harmless because outputs are filtered via `IsMine()` checks.
evidence: PR description: "Deprecated in v32 (https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35605), this deletes the useless and harmful removeprunedfunds RPC."
Commit df1f84d459: "There is never a good reason to delete tx data from a wallet, so delete these functions."
result.scope_notes: Diff is not provided, but the commit log shows removal of the RPC, migration prune step, internal deletion methods, and associated tests across 11 files.
result.card: Deletes the `removeprunedfunds` RPC (deprecated in v32) and completely removes transaction deletion code from the wallet. Migrated wallets will also no longer prune watchonly transactions during migration, avoiding unnecessary database cleanup logic since transactions lacking owned keys are ignored by standard wallet operations. This finishes deprecating a dangerous RPC and eliminates unused wallet transaction removal infrastructure.

risk.why: Completely removes an RPC method and changes legacy migration data retention, which could disrupt external scripts calling the RPC or expose unowned transaction details via gettransaction in migrated wallets.
